entries.test: Public software-engineering studies and surveys of experienced programmers could establish whether long-term maintenance is generally harder than initial writing and debugging and whether competent programmers broadly recognize that distinction.
entries.note: The sentence concerns code generally, although the drafter’s target specifies GenAI-written code. The appeal to any competent coder is ordinary rhetorical emphasis.

entries.test: Public benchmark comparisons could establish improvements by some newer coding systems, and published accident investigations could establish whether a small number of software errors can cause deaths in mission-critical systems.
entries.note: “Can be deadly” describes an empirically demonstrable hazard rather than assigning a probability to a future event. The drafter’s “could” modality does not change the source wording.
